item.title: Nakagusuku Castle Ruins — Guide
item.description: Nakagusuku Castle (Nakagusuku-jo) is one of the best-preserved of Okinawa’s gusuku (Ryukyu castles) and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, spread across a ridge in central Okinawa with commanding views. Built in stages up to the 15th century and associated with the renowned lord Gosamaru, the castle is celebrated for the beauty and sophistication of its curving limestone walls, which sweep gracefully along the contours of the hilltop and showcase several styles of Ryukyuan stone-fitting technique.
